newsitem.title: USA: Princeton Dental sells Fairfield practice.
newsitem.headline: Princeton Dental sells Fairfield practice.

text.p: Princeton Dental Corp said Monday that as of January 14 it had sold the Fairfield Dental Center practice to two doctors.
The sale price was about $885,000, of which about $410,000 was forgiveness of debt, the company said.
The practice, with 1995 revenues of about $2 million, represented about 11.9 percent of the company's total revenues, Princeton Dental said.
The company said it expects proceeds to be used to satisfy existing debt obligations and possibly for additional acquisitions.
